name: HRG_DATA_INTEG_CHECKS
description: This table stores all the data that has issue.

columns.name: DATA_INTEG_CHECK_ID
columns.description: Primary key of Data Integrity Checks.

columns.name: PARENT_ID
columns.description: Parent Id of Data Integrity Checks.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS

columns.name: REQ_START_TIME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler Job Start Time.

columns.name: REQ_END_TIME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler Job End Time.

columns.name: PROCESS_MODE
columns.description: Processing Mode of Enterprise Service Scheduler job.

columns.name: REVIEW_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to hra_tmpl_defns_b.

columns.name: REVIEW_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Performance Template Name as defined in hra_tmpl_defns_tl.

columns.name: GOAL_PLAN_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to hra_tmpl_periods_b.

columns.name: GOAL_PLAN_NAME
columns.description: Customary name of Template Periods.

columns.name: WORKER_NAME
columns.description: Display name of worker in per_person_names_f.

columns.name: MANAGER_NAME
columns.description: Display name of manager in per_person_names_f.

columns.name: TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Table Name of the data that has issue.

columns.name: TABLE_PK_COLUMN_NAME
columns.description: Primary Key column name of the issue table.

columns.name: TABLE_PK_COLUMN_VALUE
columns.description: Primary Key column value of the issue table.

columns.name: COLUMN_NAME
columns.description: Column Name of the data that has issue.

columns.name: OLD_VALUE
columns.description: Old/Current Value of data that is wrong.

columns.name: NEW_VALUE
columns.description: New/Correct Value of data that is wrong.

columns.name: ISSUE_CATEGORY
columns.description: Category of the issue identified.

columns.name: COMMENT_TEXT
columns.description: Comment text of the data quality issue.

columns.name: ERROR_TEXT
columns.description: Error Text of Enterprise Service Scheduler job failure.

columns.name: DATA_CORRECTED
columns.description: Flag for indentifying the data corrected or not.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
